scenarios.desc: Main went red and a retro is needed
scenarios.input: `main` went red yesterday after a merge and I am writing the retro at .project-toolkit/retrospective/main-red.md. What must the file contain? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 1 to 4: the filename is YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md, the failure is classified against .agents/governance/FAILURE-MODES.md, evidence links commits, PRs, or CI runs, and remediation lists follow-ups with owners or issues. 'main went red' is one of the four triggers.

scenarios.desc: Request to soften a landed retro
scenarios.input: A landed retro docs/retros/2026-10-02-bad-deploy.md names a teammate's decision harshly. I want to edit the existing sentences to soften it. How do I proceed? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST NOT 1 forbids deleting or editing landed retros to soften criticism, so corrections append a new dated section with rationale. MUST 5 requires critiquing processes and artifacts, never individuals.

scenarios.desc: Remediation commit for a retro finding
scenarios.input: The retro .project-toolkit/retrospective/2026-11-02-hook-wedge.md lists a governance fix. I am about to commit the fix with the message `fix(rules): tighten hook path rule`. Anything missing? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST NOT 2: remediation commits must not ship without linking the retro in the commit body or PR.

scenarios.input: I am writing .project-toolkit/retrospective/2026-11-10-stale-mirror.md. Nothing in the failure taxonomy fits the problem. Can I just label it 'other'? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 2: if no existing class in .agents/governance/FAILURE-MODES.md matches, the retro MUST propose a new class in a linked ADR.

scenarios.desc: Fixing a typo in an existing failure-mode taxonomy row (negative)
scenarios.input: I want to fix a typo in a row of .agents/governance/FAILURE-MODES.md. Which steps apply? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule's paths are .project-toolkit/retrospective/** and docs/retros/**. The taxonomy file sits in neither, so the retro file clauses do not apply.

scenarios.desc: Teammate asks for a scheduled retro on a quiet day
scenarios.input: Nothing failed today: no red main, no revert, no user correction, no reflect finding. A teammate says we must still drop a daily file in docs/retros/ to satisfy the pre-push habit. Is a retro owed? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: When To Write One: retros are event-triggered, never scheduled, and a day on which none of the four triggers fired owes no retrospective. The removed daily gate is the carve-out, so no retro file is authored and the file rules do not activate.
